# models.dev catalog attribution

Kodo fetches public model metadata from [models.dev/catalog.json](https://models.dev/catalog.json), with a local last-good cache and the installed pi SDK catalog as the offline initial source. The catalog is community-maintained metadata; it is not a claim of official certification by every model vendor.

License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 models.dev. Retained text: [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The license and maintenance documentation were checked at source revision `73e0b67d6484e870ab330ab3559a1b1bcea74a52`; source revision and live JSON content revision are recorded separately. Evidence is indexed in [model-catalog-sources.json](../../docs/model-catalog-sources.json). Kodo does not vendor the models.dev generator or use the research cache at runtime, and does not claim its branding.
